description: vcruz305's EXL3 SAGE mixed-precision quantization of MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash at 2.15 bits per weight (428B total, 23B active mixture of experts, 119 GB) for ExLlamaV3 and the vllm-exl3 plugin, with the DSpark draft head in dspark/. Language model only: the pack carries no vision-tower weights.
